info.title: Integrated Strategy System API
info.description: Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details with a stable `code` and a translatable `messageKey`.

AntiforgeryToken.description: The token the SPA sends back in string AntiforgerySetup.HeaderName on every state-changing call.

CreatedAccessTokenDto.description: The new token: string CreatedAccessTokenDto.Token is shown once and never stored.

EmployeeRefDto.description: A short reference to an employee shown next to units, managers and delegations.

EnrolmentResultDto.description: Result of a completed MFA enrolment: signed in, plus the recovery codes to show once.

ImportIssue.description: One problem found in an uploaded file. int ImportIssue.Row is the sheet row number; string? ImportIssue.Column a column key.

OrgTreeNodeDto.description: A node of the organisation tree (flat list; the client builds the tree from Guid? OrgTreeNodeDto.ParentId).

PagedResultOfAuthEventDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfEmployeeListItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfSampleItemDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

PagedResultOfUserDto.description: One page of items plus the total count across all pages.

ProviderField.description: One setting of a provider type. Labels come from the UI translations (`admin:providers.fields.<key>`).

ProviderTypeSchema.description: Settings form of a provider type: its fields, whether it has a secret, and whether the secret is required.

SignInOutcome.description: Outcome of a sign-in step. IReadOnlyList<string> SignInOutcome.Methods lists the second factors the user may use (or enrol).

SmtpSettingsInput.description: SMTP form. A blank string? SmtpSettingsInput.Password keeps the stored one; bool SmtpSettingsInput.ClearPassword removes it.
